I resubmit this Final Milestone PoA because it's already a month since the Milestone Reviewer approved this PoA and there's no further progress.

Notes for Milestone Reviewer:
・Most of the KPI already reach the target such as : 
・WhatsApp group reach 244 members (22% increase from the target KPI)
・Instagram account of Indonesian Cardano Community (@cardanoindonesia) reach 2,293 followers (9.19% increase from the target KPI)
・X of @Cardano_ID reach 1,043 followers (4.3% increase from the target KPI)
・Participants for the events reached 200 for offline meetup (566% increase from the target KPI)
・In addition, there are another 30 people that are attending the online workshop as well.
・Telegram group reach 1,050 members (25% below target intended in KPI)
・Our target right now is mostly new users in the blockchain & cryptocurrency, which they are still trying to understand this new “technology”. With that in mind most of them decide to follow our community through social media such as Instagram or X. Meanwhile, groups like Telegram are mostly followed by people who are experts or have known crypto for a long time to discuss and exchange deeper information. That way in the future we hope that these new followers on Instagram can have a deeper interest in knowing crypto and can join our Telegram group to learn more about crypto and Cardano blockchain.
